subtitles.en: Stu, are we expecting people to show up and break out the plastic credit card to load up on beef and goods, or what are we doing? Are we shifting and going vegan for 4th of July?
subtitles.zh: 斯图，大家会掏出信用卡买牛肉和商品吗？还是转向素食过国庆？

subtitles.en: Yeah, you know, it's not that bad, okay? I mean, when you think about it, I saw your statistics $73 there, but for 10 people at 7 bucks ahead, you know, that you can't go to a restaurant for that.
subtitles.zh: 其实没那么糟。你看，人均7美元，10个人才73美元，去餐馆可不止这个价。

subtitles.en: But anyway, here's really what it boils down to. The super star of 4th of July is this guy right here.
subtitles.zh: 但说到底，国庆节的明星是这个。

subtitles.en: Your cheeseburger, okay? Not a hamburger. Cheeseburger. Is that a brioche bun, Stu?
subtitles.zh: 芝士汉堡，不是汉堡。那是奶油面包吗？

subtitles.en: It's a brioche bun. And you know what, the bun price is the same as last year. The cheese that you see on it is the same as last year. You know what, went from $2.50 to $2.75
subtitles.zh: 是奶油面包，价格和去年一样。芝士也一样。但中间的肉从2.5美元涨到2.75美元。

subtitles.en: in the meat in the middle. So meat is driving a lot of these costs. And the reason is you know, I talked to our ranchers out in the Midwest. The fern side is at a 75 year low, okay? So
subtitles.zh: 所以肉是成本上涨的主因。我和中西部牧场主聊过，牧草面积75年最低。

subtitles.en: there's less cattle and there's more demand because everybody wants protein, everybody wants beef. So hey, supply is low, demand is high and prices go up. And this is really, to me, what's driving in
subtitles.zh: 牛少了，需求却更大，因为大家都想要蛋白质和牛肉。供不应求，价格自然上涨。
en_highlights: supply is low, demand is high

subtitles.en: place? Tomatoes are down a little bit this year, eggs are down this year, shrubberies popped up a little bit and we got really hot weather, which is affecting our farmers. They're just hoping, you
subtitles.zh: 今年番茄和鸡蛋价格略降，灌木价格微涨，炎热天气影响农民收成。
